SELECT emp03_trans_date AS trans_date, emp01_kor_nm AS emp_kor_name, f_cdnm('EmpTransCode', emp03_trans_cd, emp01_company_id, emp03_trans_date) AS trans_name, f_cdnm('EmpKindCode', emp03_kind_cd, emp01_company_id, emp03_trans_date) AS kind_name, org00_kor_nm AS org_name, f_get_empTrans(emp03_person_id, emp03_trans_date::date, 'title_nm') AS title_name, f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp03_pos_cd, emp01_company_id, emp03_trans_date) AS pos_name, f_cdnm('EmpGradeCode', emp03_grade_cd, emp01_company_id, emp03_trans_date) AS grade_name, emp03_duty AS duty, emp03_expiry_date AS expiry_date, emp03_org_head_yn AS org_head_yn, emp03_officer_yn AS officer_yn, emp03_tdm_target_yn AS tdm_target_yn, emp03_non_stay_yn AS non_stay_yn, emp03_trans_reason AS trans_reason, emp01_emp_no AS emp_no FROM emp03_trans INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = emp03_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN org00_org_info ON ( org00_org_code_id = emp03_org_code_id AND org00_company_id = #{companyId} AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info WHERE org02_code_id = emp03_org_code_id AND org02_mod_date <= emp03_trans_date )) WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp03_trans_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND UPPER(CONCAT(emp01_kor_nm, emp01_emp_no)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
AND emp03_trans_cd = #{empTransCode}

SELECT t.emp08_emp_org_nm AS emp_org_name, t.emp08_emp_kor_nm AS emp_kor_name, t.emp08_certified_nm AS certified_name, t.emp08_certified_dt AS certified_dt, t.emp08_license_no AS license_number, t.emp08_issuing_agency AS issuing_agency, t.emp08_finance_pro_type_nm AS finance_pro_type_name, t.emp08_finance_relate_yn AS finance_relate_yn, t.emp08_kofia_reg_date AS kofia_reg_date, t.emp08_note AS note FROM ( SELECT emp08_certified_dt , CONCAT(emp08_certified_nm, ' '||emp08_issuing_grade) AS emp08_certified_nm , emp08_license_no , emp08_issuing_agency , emp08_issuing_grade , emp08_note , emp08_finance_relate_yn , emp08_kofia_reg_date , f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') AS emp08_emp_org_nm , emp01_kor_nm AS emp08_emp_kor_nm , emp01_emp_no AS emp08_emp_no , emp32_finance_pro_type AS emp08_finance_pro_type , f_cdnm('FinanceProType', emp32_finance_pro_type, emp01_company_id, '2024-1-1') AS emp08_finance_pro_type_nm FROM emp08_license INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp08_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(t.emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans t WHERE t.emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND t.emp03_trans_date <= #{startDate}) LEFT JOIN emp32_relate_license ON emp32_license_id = emp08_license_id WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp03_trans_cd = ( CASE #{transCode} WHEN '100' THEN ( CASE WHEN emp03_trans_cd <= '899' /* 퇴직(900)만 제외한다. (겸직자 재직자로 인식) */ THEN emp03_trans_cd ELSE '100' END) WHEN '900' THEN '900' WHEN '800' THEN '800' ELSE emp03_trans_cd END ) AND emp08_certified_dt <= #{startDate} ) t WHERE CONCAT(t.emp08_emp_kor_nm, t.emp08_certified_nm, t.emp08_license_no, t.emp08_issuing_agency) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY t.emp08_emp_kor_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , t.emp08_certified_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , t.emp08_certified_dt

SELECT emp11_reward_dt AS reward_dt, emp01_kor_nm AS emp_kor_name, f_cdnm('EmpRewardCode', emp11_reward_cd, emp01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS reward_code_name, emp11_reward_group AS reward_group, emp11_reward_nm AS reward_name, emp11_reward_desc AS reward_desc, emp11_note AS note, emp01_emp_no AS emp_no FROM emp11_reward INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp11_person_id = emp01_person_id WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp11_reward_dt BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND UPPER(CONCAT(emp01_kor_nm, emp01_emp_no)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY emp11_reward_dt, emp01_emp_no DESC
mapper.select: SELECT q.* FROM () q ORDER BY q.trans_date, q.emp_no DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_date01, sys99_string01, sys99_string02, sys99_string03, sys99_string04, sys99_string05 , sys99_string06, sys99_string07, sys99_string08, sys99_date02 , sys99_string09, sys99_string10, sys99_string11, sys99_string12, sys99_string13 ) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , s.trans_date, COALESCE(s.emp_kor_name, ''), COALESCE(s.trans_name, ''), COALESCE(s.kind_name, ''), COALESCE(s.org_name, ''), COALESCE(s.title_name, '') , COALESCE(s.pos_name, ''), COALESCE(s.grade_name, ''), COALESCE(s.duty, ''), s.expiry_date , CASE WHEN s.org_head_yn = 'true' THEN '✓' ELSE '' END , CASE WHEN s.officer_yn = 'true' THEN '✓' ELSE '' END , CASE WHEN s.tdm_target_yn = 'true' THEN '✓' ELSE '' END , CASE WHEN s.non_stay_yn = 'true' THEN '✓' ELSE '' END , COALESCE(s.trans_reason, '') FROM () s ORDER BY s.trans_date, s.emp_no DESC

INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_string01, sys99_string02, sys99_string03, sys99_date01, sys99_string04, sys99_string05 , sys99_string06, sys99_string07, sys99_date02, sys99_string08 ) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , COALESCE(s.emp_org_name, ''), COALESCE(s.emp_kor_name, ''), COALESCE(s.certified_name, ''), s.certified_dt , COALESCE(s.license_number, ''), COALESCE(s.issuing_agency, ''), COALESCE(s.finance_pro_type_name, '') , CASE WHEN s.finance_relate_yn = 'true' THEN '✓' ELSE '' END , s.kofia_reg_date, COALESCE(s.note, '') FROM () s

INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_date01, sys99_string01, sys99_string02, sys99_string03, sys99_string04, sys99_string05, sys99_string06 ) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , s.reward_dt, COALESCE(s.emp_kor_name, ''), COALESCE(s.reward_code_name, ''), COALESCE(s.reward_group, '') , COALESCE(s.reward_name, ''), COALESCE(s.reward_desc, ''), COALESCE(s.note, '') FROM () s
